description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes for Local Authorities, including notifications about nomination periods, postponement of polling dates due to funding issues, and the announcement that a new polling date will be set once funding is secured or court decisions are made. It falls under Elections classification as it concerns election scheduling and administration under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
